The '''Assassination Unit Mark X''' was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] model manufactured by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Such droids were deployed by [[Gayem Leksende]] to [[Grommik's Residence]] in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />
